name: AU engine check — posed facial movements
notes: A positive control for the two Action Unit engines, not a behavioural
study. The M0 pilot's face was neutral throughout, so between-engine
agreement on it measured noise; this protocol makes the movements happen
and stamps what was asked for (target_aus) into each prompt's event.
Face only: no gaze calibration and no microphone. It offers only
media_retained because both AU engines run server-side on the recording —
under features_only the video is deleted and there is nothing to analyse.
Posed movements are exaggerated and clean; agreement here is an upper
bound on agreement for spontaneous behaviour, not an estimate of it.

disclosure.secondary_use: The recording is used only to test and compare the facial analysis engines in this software. It is not shared outside the research team.
disclosure.contact: Replace this with the investigator and the route to the ethics board before running anyone other than the developer.
